rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for hunger or the bodily need for food, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: After working for a long time, hunger can make it difficult to concentrate.
example.traditional: 長時間工作後，飢餓會令人難以集中精神。
example.jyutping: coeng4 si4 gaan3 gung1 zok3 hau6 gei1 ngo6 wui5 ling6 jan4 naan4 ji5 zaap6 zung1 zing1 san4

rows.note: Use this when focusing specifically on the felt sensation or physical feeling of hunger.

example.english: Experiencing intense hunger during fasting is common.
example.traditional: 禁食期間出現強烈飢餓感，係常見現象。
example.jyutping: gam3 sik6 kei4 gaan1 ceot1 jin6 koeng4 lit6 gei1 ngo6 gam2 hai6 soeng4 gin3 jin6 zoeng6
